_comment: Characters trivial enough that linear catch-up should not spend a row on them. Hardcoded on purpose — NOT derived from Anki card maturity, because a mature card means you recognise a word, not that you can write it. The bar is 'I write this so often it is automatic', not 'this has few strokes'. An explicit `xiehanzi add` ignores this list; it only filters automatic selection. Edit freely.
